title: SAP C4C Technical Lead (SDK & Functional)
description:
About the role
Cognizant is hiring an SAP C4C consultant and technical lead in Dubai who combines SDK development (Cloud Applications Studio / PDI) with functional depth in Sales and Service. You will own C4C solutions end to end, from requirements and process design through custom development, integration with SAP S/4HANA and post go-live support. Hybrid role, day shift, no travel.

What you'll do
- Gather business requirements and turn them into C4C functional designs and technical specifications
- Configure business roles and access restrictions, org structure (sales org, distribution channel, division, sales office), involved parties, workflows, approvals, surveys and KPIs/reporting
- Build in Cloud Applications Studio: custom business objects, extension fields, embedded components, BO actions and validations, mass data runs and web services
- Write ABSL logic and events for business rules and validations (e.g. duplicate checks on key fields, mandatory-field and save-time checks)
- Design and support the C4C to S/4HANA integration through Integration Suite (CPI): OData APIs, ID mapping, employee and customer master replication
- Diagnose replication and sync issues (ID mapping gaps, master data mismatches with ERP) and drive them to resolution
- Support data migration: templates, data loads, validation and post-migration reconciliation
- Write functional and technical documentation, run unit and integration testing, and support UAT and cutover
- Provide AMS support: incident analysis, root-cause identification and corrective code or data fixes
- Work with integration, Basis and frontend teams on cross-system changes
- Lead technical design of solutions that bring together generative AI, middleware (CPI, PI) and customer-facing applications
- Build and improve user interfaces and Ruby scripting components that reduce manual work
- Manage the lifecycle of custom objects and extensions with a focus on reuse and scalability
- Design secure, performant OData services for analytics, reporting, digital channels and partner systems
- Define data models, mappings and validation routines for trustworthy reporting
- Run technical reviews, testing and performance tuning across integrations, scripts and extensions
- Provide documentation and knowledge transfer to project and support teams
- Monitor usage and user feedback to drive continuous improvement

What you bring
- 5+ years of hands-on SAP C4C covering both SDK development and functional configuration (the posting cites 5-8 years overall)
- Strong SDK skills: PDI, ABSL, BODL, custom BOs, extension fields, embedded components, OData services, and patch/assemble/deploy lifecycle
- Functional C4C Sales (accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, activities, visits) and/or Service (tickets, SLAs, categorisation)
- C4C master data experience: business partners, employees, org management and ID mapping with ERP/S/4HANA
- CPI / Integration Suite and standard C4C to ERP/S/4 prepackaged content; comfortable with OData/SOAP APIs and message monitoring
- A track record fixing replication and sync defects between C4C and ERP or S/4HANA
- Practical generative AI use cases, middleware design (CPI, PI), UI development and Ruby scripting
- Good understanding of sales and service processes, data sources and reporting structures
- Background in user experience and IT business support
- Strong analysis and communication; able to work directly with business users
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience

Nice to have
- Sales/Service Cloud V2 or migration from C4C to V2
- SAP certification in C4C / Sales Cloud or Cloud Applications Studio
- Industry sales process experience (e.g. automotive, retail or financial services)
